status: OWNER-SET SOFTWARE CONTROL RANGES (OWN-DEC-020, 2026-10-07); not hardware pot ranges, not measured calibration; first product profile

product_profile.note: other quantizer/reduction rules, chain modes, quantizer-bypass diagnostics and reverse order are research/diagnostic only and are not reachable from product state; physical calibration UNSET (no voltage control)

sp_input_level_db.smoothing: 10 ms linear-in-dB ramp, proxy-rate sample clock
sp_input_level_db.event_mapping: event at host input sample m applies from proxy index m*L + R1 delay (lobes*L)

sp_input_gain.event_mapping: same proxy index mapping as sp_input_level_db; switches at that sample, no interpolation

interstage_level_db.smoothing: 10 ms linear-in-dB ramp, proxy-rate sample clock
interstage_level_db.stage: R10 (proxy grid, between SP core and MPC core)
interstage_level_db.event_mapping: event at host input sample m applies from proxy index m*L + R1 delay + SP core delay

mpc_input_gain.event_mapping: event at host input sample m applies from proxy index m*L + R1 delay + SP core delay (same boundary as R10)
mpc_input_gain.note: sensitivity labels are not full-scale calibration (OWN-DEC-008)

output_trim_db.smoothing: 10 ms linear-in-dB ramp, host-rate sample clock
output_trim_db.stage: R16 output (final output gain only; after the reference comparison point)
output_trim_db.event_mapping: event at host sample m applies from output sample m of the same call (host time; not shifted by latency)

plugin_bypass.semantics: latency-aligned dry passthrough (input delayed by the reported latency, no gains, no trim); the processing chain keeps running so state stays warm; separate from diagnostic chain modes
plugin_bypass.event_mapping: switches at the host sample of the event

state_policy.invalid_values: REJECT the whole record with a named reason (out-of-range float, unknown enum, unknown key, non-finite); nothing is silently sanitized or promoted
state_policy.unsupported_schema_version: REJECT explicitly (UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION); no migration exists because no earlier product format existed
state_policy.asset_identity_mismatch: REJECT (ASSET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH): a state written for another asset version is not applied
